name: Meirin Mashiro
source: Innocent and warm-hearted, May Lin goes out of her way to help others, at any personal expense. She always expects the best of others, and surprisingly always brings out the best in others when the more jaded observer would expect her to get taken advantage of. Even Kaito hesitates to molest her, because she's too pure to be believable.
